subject: Current State Feed = Intelligent Feed / Smart Note Feed continuity model

perspectives.ai_naya: Treat Current State Feed, Intelligent Feed, and Smart Note Feed as the same current-state continuity surface unless explicitly distinguished. Always restore current state before relevant history and use the feed to identify what changed, what matters, what was learned, what is verified, what remains, and what happens next.
perspectives.human: Shawn wants one clear current-state feed so every Naya stays tuned and up to date with what is important and relevant, reducing repeated explanation and increasing the probability of successful execution.
perspectives.machine: Strengthen the existing canonical .naya/INTELLIGENT-FEED.md rather than creating a parallel feed. Preserve .naya/memory/events as the durable intelligence authority. Wire cold-start restoration, Smart Note linkage, verification states, next-action continuity, and eventual Intelligent Hub ingestion to the same current-state projection.
perspectives.child: Instead of making the next Naya read everything, give her one place that says what is happening now, what is important, and what to do next.
perspectives.grandma: Keep the newest important truth easy to find. Keep the history safe, but do not make someone dig through old stories to learn what matters today.
